subject: Request: short-term burst subsidy & procurement path for FluxData POC
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan@fluxdata.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel@fluxdata.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term burst subsidy & procurement path for FluxData POC

Hi Susan / Daniel,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — really enjoyed the conversation about streaming inference for your recommendations engine. As discussed, FluxData wants to run a focused 72-hour soak to validate p95 latency under realistic QPS and verify throughput scaling. Key asks: 

- Short-term promotional credit to cover an estimated 200k tokens/day for 3 days (roughly 600k tokens total) to avoid billing gaps during the POC.
- Quick procurement path (PO or credit memo) so your infra team can start the night stress runs on Monday.
- Contact for any SOC/audit evidence if they want to validate data handling during the POC.

Attached is a short test plan with target scenarios and the expected traffic profile (p95 <= 50ms on our r3-large serving profile). Happy to share more telemetry once the runs start.

Can you confirm procurement contact and whether FluxData can accept a small promotional voucher, or if they need a formal PO? If you need us to loop in RevOps, I can do that — quick turnaround would help them meet their Monday window.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:03:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term burst subsidy & procurement path for FluxData POC

Hi Jonas,

Thanks — the plan looks good at a glance. Two quick questions before we loop procurement: 

1) Can Redwood provide the credits as a one-time promotional voucher that we can apply to the trial account, or do you require a PO?
2) We may need the SOC 2 evidence packet (or a pointer to the secured evidence) — who should we contact for that?

Procurement-wise, I can route a PO to procurement@fluxdata.com if Redwood needs that; otherwise a voucher is faster for us. We want to kick off a night soak starting Monday 05/17 at 11pm PT and run through 05/20.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Susan

Head of Engineering, FluxData

Susan — looping in Priyom (SE) and Marissa (RevOps) to help with the delivery.

Priyom / Marissa — FluxData would like a short 72-hour burst credit to validate latency/throughput. Details: ~600k tokens total, night soak window Mon 05/17 11pm PT — Thu 05/20. They prefer a promotional voucher for speed but can accept a PO if that’s required for accounting. Also they want SOC 2 evidence before the runs.

Priyom, can you confirm whether the requested volume fits within our promo policy and whether we can lock a voucher to their trial account for the timeframe? Marissa, please advise on voucher vs PO process and any approval path / promo code we should use.

Thanks all — goal is to have credits applied by EOD Monday so they can start the soak.

Jonas
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Hi team,

Confirmed — 600k tokens for a 72-hour soak is within the SE-sponsored promo envelope for an early-stage pilot. We can provision a time-limited voucher tied to the FluxData trial account that will automatically apply to usage between 2027-05-17T06:00:00Z and 2027-05-20T06:00:00Z. 

Conditions / notes:
- Voucher will only cover hosted API usage (not private deployment costs). If they plan to run on Dedicated or Private infra, we need to re-evaluate.
- We’ll require an internal quick-approval from RevOps for the promotional amount — Marissa, requesting a one-click approval or a short-code you prefer.
- For SOC 2 evidence, the security team can share the redacted packet and an access link; Marissa can coordinate the request.

Susan — please confirm the account email for the trial (the voucher will be bound to that account) and whether FluxData will run the soak in the hosted environment. If you prefer a PO instead of the voucher, we can accept a PO but it will add ~2–3 business days for billing reconciliation.

I’ll stand by to apply the voucher once RevOps signs off.

Cheers,
Priyom Das

priyom_das@redwood.com
